hints.title: Significant Bit Complement Mask
hints.text: The complement must flip each bit within the significant bit representation of num without flipping higher-order leading zeroes into ones.

hints.title: All Ones Mask Invariant
hints.text: Constructing an all-ones bitmask having the exact bit length of num allows flipping every relevant bit via bitwise exclusive disjunction.

hints.title: Bitmask Extension Procedure
hints.text: Initialize mask to one. While mask is less than num, shift mask left by one and set the lowest bit to one. Return num bitwise exclusive-ored with mask.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(1) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Applying standard bitwise NOT flips leading zeros to ones in 32-bit registers, yielding negative numbers in two complement arithmetic.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Creating the length-bounded mask takes at most 32 operations in O(1) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should explain why ~num alone fails in fixed-width integers and how an all-ones mask isolates significant bits.
